Next authorized gate: semantic IR and executable grammar
What etymology means in Era Zero

Era Zero is an engineered language, so its valid etymology is auditable synchronic derivation—not an invented proto-language, fictional sound change, or claim of English ancestry. Every record explains how the form follows from the fixed family, three-trit address, generated compact root, formal carrier, harmonic signature, relative note path, semantic review, and where applicable the approved compound graph.

Each atomic entry records its family onset and harmony; the first, second, and third address axes; resolved universal slot; the three compact-root segments; the family-qualified transliteration; the carrier syllables; the relative note path; the invariant definition; and semantic authority provenance. The 36 source-canonical atoms—LIF:000–222 and MOV:000–022—remain traced directly to the source. The other 288 atoms identify the exact effective approval migration that established their canonical meanings.

Each compound entry records its explicit semantic head, all component nodes, qualifies and fills-role edges, architecture version, invariant definition, full SHA-256 semantic digest, and content-derived CMP identifier. English titles are indexing glosses only. Runtime state, contour, register, absolute pitch, tense, and discourse realization are not part of lexical derivation.
• Gate 4C — 436 English sense records across 419 lemmas;
• Gate 4E — 352 formal etymology and derivation records.

General-English translation remains unauthorized. The next work is the semantic IR and executable grammar: clause structure, typed roles, attachment and scope, negation, quantity, modality, reference time, state transitions, coordination, seriality, parallelism, repetition, recursion, and canonical serialization.
